newsitem.title: USA: Exec Telecard unaware of cause for shr move.
newsitem.headline: Exec Telecard unaware of cause for shr move.

text.p: Executive TeleCard Ltd said on Thursday that it is unaware of any specific reason for unusual activity in its stock today.
The company said there are no negative material announcements pending.

Executive TeleCard shares traded at 9-1/8, off 1/2, on 174,100 shares of volume. A company spokeswoman said the statement was a response to the drop in share price and Nasdaq did not request the company to put out a statement.
Executive TeleCard shares, however, did hit a low of 8 during the day, prompting the announcement by the company, a spokeswoman said.
